steps.text: Whisk the flour, cornflour and lager to a batter.
Cut the potatoes into chips, rinse and dry them.
Fry the chips twice, first at a lower heat, then hot to crisp.
Dip the fish strips in batter and fry at 180C until golden.
Serve in paper cones with tartare and lemon.

note: drawn butter, shell optional, Madison eats it all

steps.text: Boil the lobsters in salted water, allowing about 8 minutes per 500g of weight.
Melt half the butter with the garlic. Keep the rest for drawn butter.
Split the lobsters lengthways and crack the claws. Brush the flesh with the garlic butter.
Grill flesh-side up until hot and lightly golden.
Serve with drawn butter and lemon.

note: Beef chuck simmered 3 hours with chipotles, tomatoes and kidney beans

dish.make_ahead: Better the next day, keep chilled

steps.text: Brown the beef in batches.
Add the tomatoes, cumin, chipotles and water to cover.
Simmer until it falls apart.
Add the kidney beans for the last 30 minutes.
Ladle into bowls with cheddar.

note: Grilled franks in steamed buns with beef chili, mustard, onion and relish

dish.n: Dee-Luxe hot dogs with the works

steps.text: Simmer the mince with cumin, chilli powder and water until loose.
Griddle the franks and steam the buns.
Dice the onion.
Fill the buns with franks and top with chilli, mustard, raw onion and relish.

note: Garlic rosemary roast lamb leg, roast potatoes, peas, mint sauce

dish.n: Easter Sunday roast lamb with mint sauce
dish.make_ahead: Mint sauce up to 1 day ahead, roast fresh

steps.text: Make small cuts all over the lamb and push in slivers of garlic and rosemary sprigs.
Rub with oil and salt.
Roast at 190C for medium.
Rest the lamb.
Peel the potatoes and parboil them.
Roast the potatoes in oil alongside.
For mint sauce, chop the mint with sugar, add boiling water and malt vinegar.
Toss the peas in butter and serve alongside.

note: Crackling roast pork belly with apple sauce and buttery mashed potatoes

dish.n: Orgocorp crackling pork belly with mash
dish.make_ahead: Pork can be salted a day ahead

steps.text: Score the skin and rub with salt, then dry in the fridge overnight if you can.
Roast at 160C until tender.
Blast at 240C until the crackling bubbles.
Meanwhile boil the potatoes and mash with butter.
Simmer the apples with water into a sauce.
Slice the pork and serve over the mash with apple sauce.

note: 524 recipes, one blog, one tiny Queens kitchen

dish.make_ahead: Better made 1 day ahead, reheat gently

steps.text: Dry the beef and brown it in batches with the lardons.
Soften the carrots, onion and garlic in the same pot.
Return the meat, add the wine, stock and herbs and bring to a simmer.
Braise covered at 160C for 3 hours until the beef is tender.
Glaze the pearl onions and mushrooms in the butter and stir through at the end.

note: Thin crust pizza with crushed tomato, mozzarella and crumbled Italian sausage

steps.text: Heat the oven to its highest setting with a steel or tray inside.
Stretch the dough thin into two bases and spread with salted crushed tomato.
Top with mozzarella and crumbled sausage meat, skins removed.
Bake each pizza at max heat until the crust blisters.

note: Beef and pork meatloaf with a tomato glaze

steps.text: Mix the mince, breadcrumbs, egg, grated onion and Worcestershire.
Press into a loaf tin and glaze with tomato sauce mixed with brown sugar.
Bake at 180C.
Boil the potatoes while the meatloaf bakes.
Rest the meatloaf, mash the potatoes with butter and milk and serve thick slices.

note: Foil-baked paprika pork ribs finished over coals, grilled corn, coleslaw

dish.n: Ohio barbecue ribs with corn and slaw
dish.make_ahead: Ribs wrapped up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Rub the ribs with the paprika, sugar and salt, then wrap in foil.
Bake at 150C for 3 hours.
Brush with barbecue sauce and finish over hot coals until sticky.
Grill the corn. Toss the cabbage, carrot and mayonnaise into a crunchy coleslaw.

note: Seared sirloin basted in garlic butter, creamed spinach, roast potatoes

dish.make_ahead: Sauce up to 1 day, cook steak fresh

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into chunks and roast at 220C until crisp.
Sear the steaks in a smoking pan, baste with butter and garlic, then rest.
Wilt the spinach and simmer with the cream until thick.
Slice the steak and serve with the potatoes and creamed spinach.

note: Beef chuck slow cooked in Worcestershire gravy and baked under pastry

dish.make_ahead: Filling up to 2 days, bake fresh

steps.text: Dice the beef and toss with the flour. Slice the onions.
Brown the beef in batches.
Add the onions and thyme and cook briefly, then add the Worcestershire sauce and stock. Cover and simmer gently until tender and thick.
Pour into a large pie dish and cool slightly.
Cover with puff pastry, brush with beaten egg and bake at 200C.

note: Sirloin steaks with garlic butter and crisp smashed potatoes

steps.text: Boil the potatoes until just tender, drain, smash flat on a tray, drizzle with oil and roast at 220C.
Season the steaks and sear in a hot pan on both sides.
Add most of the butter, the garlic and thyme and baste briefly. Rest the steaks.
Add the wine and stock to the pan and reduce by half.
Saute the beans in the remaining butter. Serve with the steaks and potatoes.

note: Crumbed chicken breast under ham, tomato sauce and melted mozzarella

dish.make_ahead: Best served hot

steps.text: Crumb the chicken in flour, egg and panko.
Shallow fry until golden and cooked through.
Simmer the tomato with the garlic.
Top with ham, tomato and mozzarella and grill until bubbling.
Serve with hot chips and a green salad.

note: flambéed tableside, like the opening night

steps.text: Flatten the steaks and sear hot for 2 minutes a side, then rest.
In the same pan soften the shallots and garlic in the butter, add the brandy and flame.
Stir in the mustard, Worcestershire, stock and cream and reduce.
Return the steaks to coat in the sauce.

note: delivered to the door, the delivery kid becomes a star

dish.make_ahead: Dough can be made a day ahead

steps.text: Rest the dough at room temperature so it relaxes. Season the tomatoes with salt and oregano.
Stretch the bases thin, spread with sauce and top with the mozzarella and pepperoni.
Bake on a preheated tray at the oven's highest setting until bubbling and golden.

film: Glass Onion: A Knives Out Mystery (2022)
note: Lemon, garlic and oregano lamb skewers grilled and served in pita

dish.make_ahead: Marinate up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Cut the lamb leg into cubes and marinate 2 hours with the juice of the lemon, the garlic cloves, the dried oregano and the oil.
Thread onto skewers and grill 8 minutes, turning.
Serve in the warm pitas with the Greek yoghurt mixed with grated cucumber, plus tomato and onion.

note: Seared sirloin, loaded baked potato and iceberg wedge with blue cheese dressing

steps.text: Bake the potatoes at 200C for an hour.
Cut the iceberg into four wedges and mash the blue cheese with some of the sour cream.
Sear the steaks, pull at 54C and rest.
Spoon the dressing over the wedges and load the potatoes with sour cream and chives.

note: Beef chuck braised with carrots, celery and potatoes

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheats well

steps.text: Brown the beef all over.
Add the onion, carrots, celery and stock.
Cover and braise at 160C.
Add the potatoes and braise for the last hour.
Slice and serve with the juices.

note: Cold roast beef, caramelised onion, rocket, beetroot and horseradish cream

dish.n: Big Red's Cup day roast beef rolls
dish.make_ahead: Beef up to 1 day ahead, assemble fresh

steps.text: Rub the beef with oil, salt and pepper.
Sear all over.
Roast at 200C for rare.
Rest, then chill before slicing thinly.
Slice the onions.
Slowly fry the onions in butter.
Mix the sour cream with horseradish cream.
Split the rolls, spread with horseradish cream and fill with beef, onions, rocket and sliced pickled beetroot.

note: Beef chuck braised 3 hours with tomato paste and Worcestershire, peas, spinach

dish.make_ahead: Up to 3 days

steps.text: Dice the beef, onions, garlic and celery.
Brown the beef in batches, then soften the vegetables.
Add the tomato paste, Worcestershire sauce and stock, return the beef, cover and braise at 160C.
Stir in the peas and spinach for the last 5 minutes so it turns green. Serve with crusty bread.

note: soup in a thermos, PB and J with the crusts cut off

dish.make_ahead: Soup up to 2 days, keep chilled and reheat

steps.text: Halve the tomatoes and roast with the onion, garlic and oil at 200C until softened and browned.
Transfer to a pot with the stock and simmer.
Blitz smooth with the cream and season. Pour into warmed thermoses.
Make four peanut butter and jam sandwiches, cut off the crusts and serve with the soup.

film: The Naked Gun: From the Files of Police Squad! (1988)
note: Griddled franks in steamed buns under slow simmered beef chili

steps.text: Dice the onions.
Brown the mince with one onion and the chilli powder. Add the tomatoes.
Simmer.
Griddle the franks and steam the buns.
Fill the buns, spoon over chilli and top with cheddar and the diced raw onion.

note: Beef chuck, onion, carrots and potatoes cooked slowly until thick

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheat to serve

steps.text: Brown the beef in a heavy pot.
Add the onions, carrots, potatoes, stock and thyme.
Put the lid on and cook over low coals or at 160C until thick.
Slice the pork thin and toss with a little of the soy.
Slice the cabbage, carrots and capsicum.
Heat the oil in a wok until smoking and stir-fry the pork until browned.
Add the vegetables and ginger and stir-fry briefly.
Add the noodles, oyster sauce and remaining soy, toss and serve in bowls.

note: Pork and hominy soup with guajillo chilli

steps.text: Soak the chillies in hot water. Halve the onion and peel the garlic.
Simmer the pork with onion and garlic in the water.
Blend the chillies with garlic, stir in with the hominy and simmer.
Shred the cabbage and slice the radishes.
Serve topped with cabbage, radish, oregano and lime.

note: Beef and pork meatballs with parmesan simmered in garlic basil tomato sauce

dish.make_ahead: Sauce up to 2 days ahead

steps.text: Mix both minces with the soaked breadcrumbs, parmesan, parsley and seasoning.
Roll into balls and brown in the oil in batches.
Add the garlic, tomatoes and basil to the pan and simmer the meatballs gently.
Cook the spaghetti in salted water while the sauce finishes.
Toss the pasta with the sauce and serve with extra parmesan.

note: Barbecue glazed chicken thighs with mac and cheese and silverbeet

steps.text: Bake the chicken thighs at 200C for 25 minutes, brush with the barbecue sauce and bake some more.
Make mac and cheese from the macaroni, the butter, the flour, the milk and the cheddar.
Serve with the sautéed silverbeet.

note: Beef and pork ragù layered with béchamel and lasagne sheets

dish.make_ahead: Assemble up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Brown the mince, add the tomatoes and wine and simmer for 2 hours.
Make a bechamel with the butter, flour and milk.
Layer the meat sauce, pasta sheets and bechamel in a dish, finishing with mozzarella.
Bake at 180C for 45 minutes.
Rest for 20 minutes before cutting.

note: Turkey breast rolled around sage stuffing, roasted with potatoes

steps.text: Fry the chopped onion with sage and mix with the breadcrumbs for stuffing.
Butterfly the turkey, spread with stuffing, roll and tie.
Peel the potatoes and trim the sprouts.
Roast the turkey with the potatoes at 180C.
Roast the sprouts for the last stretch.
Rest the turkey, slice and serve with cranberry sauce.

note: Lamb mince with carrots and peas under buttery mash

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, assemble and bake when needed

steps.text: Dice the onion and grate the carrots.
Brown the mince with the onion and carrot.
Add the peas and stock and simmer until thick.
Peel and chop the potatoes, boil until tender, then mash with butter and milk.
Spread the mince in a dish and top with the mash.
Bake at 200C until golden.

note: Slow-baked ribs glazed with barbecue sauce, buttered corn and slaw

steps.text: Rub the pork ribs with salt, pepper and smoked paprika, wrap in foil and bake at 160C for 2 hours.
Unwrap, brush with the barbecue sauce and grill until sticky.
Serve with the buttered corn cobs and the coleslaw mixed with mayonnaise.

note: the date they're not supposed to have

dish.make_ahead: Shallot butter up to 3 days

steps.text: Simmer the shallots with the wine until almost dry. Cool, then mix into the butter with the salt and chill.
Cut the potatoes into frites, rinse and dry thoroughly.
Fry in oil at 140C, then drain and cool.
Fry again at 185C until crisp. Salt lightly.
Season the steaks and sear hard in a hot pan with the oil to your preferred doneness.
Rest the steaks, then slice and top with the shallot red wine butter. Serve with frites.

note: Creamy potato and leek soup topped with crisp bacon and chives

dish.make_ahead: Up to 3 days chilled

steps.text: Soften the leeks and onion in butter.
Add the potatoes and stock.
Simmer until tender.
Fry the bacon until crisp.
Blend with the cream until silky.
Top with bacon and chives and serve with crusty bread.

note: Thin crust pepperoni and mozzarella pizza with black olive craters

steps.text: Heat the oven and a tray to 250C.
Stretch the dough into two rounds and spread with crushed tomatoes.
Cover with mozzarella, then arrange pepperoni like planets and olive slices like craters.
Bake on the hot tray until blistered.

note: Slow cooked beef chuck chili with chipotle, cumin and cocoa

dish.make_ahead: Better the next day, keeps 3 days

steps.text: Brown the beef in batches in oil
Soften the onions and garlic
Add the chipotle, cumin, cocoa, tomatoes, beans and beef
Cover and braise at 160C until thick
Serve topped with sour cream and cheddar

note: Hot dogs under spiced beef chilli and melted cheese

ingredients.item: onions, 1 diced for the chilli and 1 finely diced to serve

steps.text: Brown the mince with the diced onion, then add the spices, passata and a splash of water.
Simmer until thick.
Grill the frankfurts, turning, and toast the split buns.
Fill the buns with frankfurts and chilli, top with cheddar and grill until melted.
Finish with raw diced onion and a squeeze of mustard.

note: Smashed beef patties, cheese, onion and pickles on potato buns

steps.text: Slowly cook the sliced onions in butter for 15 minutes until golden.
Mix the mayo, the tomato sauce, the mustard and the chopped pickles.
Roll the beef mince into balls.
On a very hot barbecue plate, smash each flat, season and cook 2 minutes.
Flip, add a cheese slice and cook 1 minute.
Toast the potato buns, spread with sauce and stack the patties each with onion and pickles.

note: watching the Series on the radio

dish.make_ahead: Dough needs 1 to 2 days in the fridge

steps.text: Mix the flour, yeast, salt and water and knead. Divide into two balls.
Refrigerate covered to cold-ferment for a day or two.
Bring to room temperature.
Heat a pizza steel at the oven's maximum, about 250 to 275C.
Remove the sausage from its casings, crumble and pan-fry until cooked.
Stretch the dough thin into two pizzas. Top with tomatoes, mozzarella and sausage.
Bake each on the steel until crisp and cooked, then cut into wedges.

note: Short ribs baked 4 hours in foil, then glazed with barbecue sauce

steps.text: Rub the ribs with salt, pepper and smoked paprika and wrap in foil.
Bake at 150C for 4 hours.
Unwrap, brush with barbecue sauce and glaze under a hot grill.
Shred the cabbage with mayo for slaw.

note: prawns, dill and mayo on buttered toast

steps.text: Chop the prawns
Fold with the mayo, creme fraiche, dill, lemon juice and horseradish
Fry the bread in butter until golden
Pile the prawns on top and add a little roe if you have it

note: Rump cap grilled over coals and sliced, with warm pinto beans

dish.n: Haywood Ranch grilled tri-tip and beans

steps.text: Rub the rump cap with salt, pepper and garlic.
Grill over coals, fat side first, until 54C inside.
Rest for 10 minutes.
Warm the beans. Mix the tomatoes, onion, coriander and lime for salsa.
Slice the meat and serve.

note: the Chinatown restaurant where it all kicks off

steps.text: Thinly slice the beef and marinate with the light soy, cornflour and sesame oil.
Gently separate the noodles.
Stir-fry the beef in two batches in a hot wok and set aside.
Fry the noodles in more oil.
Add the bean sprouts, sliced spring onions and soy sauces. Return the beef and toss over high heat until piping hot.

film: Talladega Nights: The Ballad of Ricky Bobby (2006)
note: Buttermilk fried chicken, homemade pizza and hard shell tacos, Bobby family style

dish.n: Fried chicken, pizza and tacos dinner
dish.make_ahead: Chicken can be brined the day before

steps.text: Brine the chicken in the buttermilk.
Dredge in seasoned flour and fry at 165C until cooked through and crisp.
Stretch the dough, top with sauce and mozzarella and bake at 230C until bubbling.
Brown the beef mince with the cumin and taco spices.
Fill the taco shells and put everything out together.

note: Chuck beef, carrot and onion slow-cooked in stout

dish.n: Light horse camp beef and stout stew
dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, keep chilled and reheat

steps.text: Dice the chuck, onions and carrots and toss the beef in flour.
Brown the beef in batches in oil.
Add the onions, carrots and garlic and cook.
Add the tomato paste, stout, stock, thyme and bay leaves.
Cover and simmer gently until the beef is tender.
Peel and chop the potatoes.
Boil the potatoes until tender and mash with butter and milk.
Spoon the stew over the mash.

note: Sliced rump, mushrooms, paprika and sour cream sauce

steps.text: Slice the onion and mushrooms.
Sear the beef in batches and set aside.
Cook the onion and mushrooms until golden and stir in the paprika.
Stir in the sour cream and return the beef, warming through without boiling.
Cook the noodles, toss in butter and serve the stroganoff over the top.

note: Stir fried chicken, broccoli, red capsicum and egg noodles in soy sauce

dish.make_ahead: Best fresh, or reheat the noodles in a pan

steps.text: Slice the chicken, broccoli and capsicum.
Stir fry the chicken in the oil until browned.
Add the broccoli and capsicum and cook until bright.
Toss through the noodles with soy sauce and honey until sticky.
Pack into takeaway boxes.

note: Crackling pork loin with roast potatoes and chunky sage apple sauce

dish.make_ahead: Dry the pork the night before

steps.text: Score the pork and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight.
Salt well and roast at 240C to start the crackling.
Drop to 180C and roast until 63C inside, adding the potatoes tossed in oil alongside.
Meanwhile cook the apples with sage and a little sugar to a chunky sauce.
Rest the pork before carving.

note: Fried pork roll, fried egg and American cheese on a soft roll

dish.n: RST Video pork roll, egg and cheese
dish.make_ahead: Best fresh

steps.text: Nick the edges of the pork roll slices and fry until curled and browned.
Fry the eggs.
Stack pork roll, egg and cheese into the rolls, add tomato sauce, salt and pepper.
Wrap in foil for a couple of minutes to melt.

note: Seared chicken breast in tarragon cream sauce, potatoes and beans

dish.make_ahead: Sauce up to 1 day ahead, sear the chicken fresh

steps.text: Halve the potatoes and dice the shallot.
Roast the potatoes in oil at 220C.
Season the chicken breasts.
Sear skin-side down in a hot pan.
Flip and roast at 200C.
Rest the chicken.
Fry the shallot in the pan, add the wine and reduce.
Add the cream, Dijon and tarragon and simmer.
Cook the beans and toss in butter.
Serve with the potatoes.

note: Lamb shoulder braised with cumin, cinnamon and pumpkin, over couscous

steps.text: Brown the lamb in oil
Soften the onions with the cumin and cinnamon
Add the stock and tomatoes and braise at 160C
Add the pumpkin for the last hour
Prepare the couscous as the packet says
Serve the stew over the couscous

note: Garlic thyme beef rib roast, roast potatoes, horseradish cream

steps.text: Rub the beef rib roast with the crushed garlic cloves, thyme and salt.
Roast at 220C for 20 minutes, then 180C for 45 minutes for medium rare, and rest 20 minutes.
Roast the potatoes in chunks alongside.
Carve at the table with the horseradish cream.

note: Tomato fish stew with white fish, prawns and potato, garlic toast

dish.n: Long John Silver's galley fish stew
dish.make_ahead: Stew up to 1 day, add the seafood when reheating

steps.text: Dice the onion, capsicum and potatoes and crush the garlic.
Fry the onion, capsicum and garlic in oil.
Add smoked paprika, crushed tomatoes, fish stock and potatoes.
Simmer until the potato is nearly tender.
Add the fish chunks and prawns and simmer until just cooked.
Stir in parsley.
Toast the sourdough, rub with garlic and serve alongside.

note: Rump strips and mushrooms in creamy sauce over egg noodles

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, reheat gently

steps.text: Slice the rump into thin strips, the onion and the mushrooms.
Sear the beef in batches in a hot pan with oil, then remove.
Fry the onion and mushrooms in butter.
Add the paprika, Dijon and stock and simmer.
Stir in the sour cream and the beef and warm through without boiling.
Cook the egg noodles, toss in butter and dill and serve under the beef.

film: Star Wars: Episode II - Attack of the Clones (2002)
note: Beef patty melts with onions and Swiss on rye, crinkle-cut fries

dish.n: Dex's Diner patty melts and fries
dish.make_ahead: Onions up to 2 days ahead

steps.text: Cook the onions slowly until golden.
Shape the mince into 4 thin patties and sear. Layer on rye with the onions and Swiss.
Butter the outside of the bread and grill until melted.
Fry the chips on a low heat until soft, then again on a high heat until golden. Serve with pickles.

note: Garlic rosemary beef sirloin roast with crisp roast potatoes

dish.n: Whoville roast beast with crispy potatoes

steps.text: Rub the beef with the garlic, rosemary, oil and salt.
Parboil the potatoes, drain, rough up and toss in duck fat.
Roast the potatoes at 200C and the beef for medium rare, adding the carrots tossed in honey for the last part.
Rest the beef.
Whisk the flour into the pan juices with the stock and simmer to make gravy.

note: the gang's home turf

dish.make_ahead: Chilli up to 2 days ahead

steps.text: Dice the onion and keep a quarter aside for topping. Mince the garlic.
Fry the rest of the onion in the oil with the garlic, then add the mince and brown well.
Stir in the tomato paste, spices, tomatoes and water and simmer. Season with salt.
Bake the fries as directed on the packet.
Griddle the franks until piping hot and warm the buns. Fill with franks and chilli and finish with onion and mustard.

note: Beef shin, carrots, potatoes and pearl barley braised 3 hours, with bread

dish.make_ahead: Better the next day

steps.text: Brown the beef in batches.
Soften the onions, then add the carrots, potatoes, pearl barley and stock.
Cover and braise at 160C until thick and tender.
Serve with bread to stretch it further.

film: Austin Powers: International Man of Mystery (1997)
note: Sirloin in mushroom, brandy and cream sauce, fries and watercress

dish.n: Dr. Evil's one million dollar steak Diane

steps.text: Bake the fries at 220C until crisp.
Bat out the steaks to about 1cm thick, season and sear in a very hot oiled pan, then rest on a plate.
In the same pan melt the butter and fry the mushrooms and shallot.
Add the brandy and let it bubble off, then add the Worcestershire, mustard and cream and simmer.
Pour the sauce over the steaks and serve with the fries and watercress.

note: Chicken with saffron, preserved lemon and green olives, couscous

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheat gently

steps.text: Brown the chicken in the oil.
Soften the sliced onions with the ginger and saffron.
Return the chicken with the water, chopped preserved lemon rind and olives and simmer.
Pour the couscous into the boiling stock, cover for a few minutes and fluff.

note: Lamb shoulder braised with harissa, cumin, tomato and chickpeas

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheats well

steps.text: Dice the lamb and brown it in the oil in batches.
Stir in the harissa and cumin.
Add the tomatoes, chickpeas and water.
Cover and braise at 160C until it pulls apart.
Warm the flatbread and serve alongside.

note: Beef and pork meatloaf with a tomato glaze, mash and peas

steps.text: Soak the breadcrumbs in the milk. Grate the onion.
Mix lightly with the beef and pork mince and egg, and press into a loaf tin.
Glaze with the tomato sauce mixed with the sugar and bake at 180C.
Peel and boil the potatoes and mash. Cook the peas.

note: the lunch where Grant, Sattler and Malcolm argue with Hammond

dish.make_ahead: Crumb the lamb up to 4 hours ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Brush the lamb racks with Dijon, then press on the parsley and breadcrumbs.
Toss the potatoes in oil and salt and put on a tray in a 220C oven.
Roast the lamb alongside the potatoes until 55C inside, about 20 minutes.
Rest the lamb 10 minutes while you boil the peas with the mint, drain and blitz with the butter. Slice the lamb and plate neatly.

note: Pepper-crusted rump steak with two fried eggs and crisp hash browns

steps.text: Grate the potatoes and squeeze dry.
Fry as hash brown cakes in butter until crisp.
Season the steaks with cracked pepper and sear to medium-rare.
Rest the steaks.
Fry the eggs and toast the bread.
Serve each steak with two eggs, hash browns and buttered toast.

note: one hand on the bars, eaten between drops

dish.n: Wilee's halal cart chicken over rice

steps.text: Marinate the chicken in the lemon juice, oregano, cumin and coriander.
Cook the rice with the turmeric.
Mix the yoghurt, mayo, vinegar, sugar and pepper into a white sauce.
Griddle the chicken until cooked through, then chop.
Serve on shredded lettuce with rice, white sauce and hot sauce.

note: Pork knuckle roasted until the crackling blisters, with buttered potatoes

dish.make_ahead: Simmer a day ahead, roast fresh

steps.text: Simmer the knuckles with the onion, bay leaves and caraway seeds for an hour and a half.
Lift out, pat very dry, score and rub with salt.
Roast at 220C until the crackling blisters.
Boil the potatoes and toss with butter and parsley. Warm the sauerkraut with a little cooking liquid.
Serve with wholegrain mustard.

note: Baked bread and egg casserole with ham, spinach and gruyère

dish.make_ahead: Assemble the night before, bake fresh

steps.text: Butter a 2L baking dish.
Tear the bread and layer with the diced ham, spinach and grated gruyere.
Whisk the eggs with milk, Dijon, salt and pepper and pour over.
Press down and cover.
Chill for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Bake at 180C until puffed and golden.
Rest before serving with tomato relish.

note: Pineapple and soy marinated chicken thighs glazed, with coconut rice

dish.make_ahead: Marinate up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Marinate the chicken in the pineapple juice, soy, ginger and garlic.
Grill the chicken until cooked through, turning.
Simmer the marinade until reduced to a glaze and brush over.
Cook the rice in the coconut milk and water.
Serve the chicken over the rice.

film: Walk Hard: The Dewey Cox Story (2007)
note: Buttermilk fried chicken with mashed potatoes and pepper gravy

steps.text: Soak the chicken pieces overnight in the buttermilk with the hot sauce and the salt.
Dredge in the plain flour mixed with the paprika, the garlic powder and the pepper.
Fry at 160C for 12 to 15 minutes until 75C inside.
Mash the potatoes with the butter and the milk.
For gravy, whisk the frying oil with the flour, then the milk, simmer until thick and season with lots of pepper.
